_comment: Source word -> plain-letter respelling fed to XTTS so it pronounces hard words correctly. Keys match case-insensitively on whole words; use single-token respellings (no spaces/hyphens) to keep chunk word-alignment stable. ONLY add an entry after proving it with scripts/regen_chunk.py (before/after severity must drop and the heard text must converge on the correct sound) — hand-guessed respellings often do nothing or make XTTS worse.
